name: Cast #1 stroke
description: Forward stroke of Cast #1 from The Rod & The Cast: the rod-butt angle sweeps clockwise from up-and-back (128 deg) through the vertical to up-and-forward (43 deg), and the hand hauls forward and slightly up, stopping at RSP (t = 0). Sampled every 2.5 ms.

source.reference: Grunde Løvoll and Jason Borger, The Rod & The Cast (2006); https://www.sexyloops.com/articles/rodcast.shtml
source.method: Fitted by eye to the high-speed footage (RSP = frame 0317); indicative, not a digitised trajectory.

hand_path.form: smoothstep 3u^2 - 2u^3 from t0 to t_stop, ends held

source.sampling: the angle and hand path above, sampled every 2.5 ms from -0.40 s to 0.13 s
